deploy.startCommand: mkdir -p storage/app/public/profiles storage/app/public/attachments storage/app/public/complaints storage/framework/{cache/data,sessions,views} storage/logs && rm -rf public/storage 2>/dev/null; php artisan migrate --force && php artisan storage:seed && php artisan config:cache && php artisan route:cache && ln -sf /app/storage/app/public /app/public/storage && php -d upload_max_filesize=25M -d post_max_size=130M -d memory_limit=256M -d max_file_uploads=10 -S 0.0.0.0:${PORT:-8000} -t /app/public /app/server.php
